title: SWF: PlaceObject2 with move flag for position-only updates
description: In the SWF display list, if an object's character ID is the same across two consecutive keyframes but position/transform changed, emit PlaceObject2 with the Move flag (bit 0) instead of re-defining the character. Check packages/swf/src/compile.ts — find how PlaceObject2 is emitted between keyframes. If it always re-places characters, optimize: track if charId was previously placed at this depth, and if so, emit Move-only PlaceObject2. Add unit tests.
